title: IBM QPU connectivity check (read-only)
description: Run the read-only QPU connectivity check script. This verifies IBM Quantum credentials work WITHOUT submitting any hardware jobs or spending QPU seconds.
objectives: Run the script in read-only mode (no --confirm-qpu flag)
Report: authentication success/failure, available backends, quota/usage info
Report the exact output of the script
constraints: NEVER use --confirm-qpu or submit any hardware job
Zero QPU seconds may be spent
If credentials are missing or invalid, report and stop — do not attempt to fix keys
